# Local infrastructure for native development.
# Runtime Python services are started with process-compose.yaml.
services:
  postgresql:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgresql_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./scripts/data/gesetze-normen-seed.sql.gz:/seed/gesetze-normen-seed.sql.gz:ro
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: postgres
    configs:
      - source: postgresql_init_sql
        target: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql
      - source: postgresql_seed_gesetze_normen
        target: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/seed-gesetze-normen.sh
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d postgres"]
      interval: 3s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30

  temporal:
    image: temporalio/auto-setup:1.29.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "7233:7233"
    volumes:
      - ./docker/temporal/development-sql.yaml:/etc/temporal/config/dynamicconfig/development-sql.yaml
    environment:
      DB: postgres12
      DB_PORT: 5432
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PWD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_SEEDS: postgresql
      DYNAMIC_CONFIG_FILE_PATH: config/dynamicconfig/development-sql.yaml
      BIND_ON_IP: 0.0.0.0
      TEMPORAL_ADDRESS: 0.0.0.0:7233
      TEMPORAL_CLI_ADDRESS: 0.0.0.0:7233
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "tctl", "--address", "temporal:7233", "cluster", "h"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 60

  temporal-init:
    image: temporalio/admin-tools:1.29
    depends_on:
      temporal:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      TEMPORAL_ADDRESS: temporal:7233
      TEMPORAL_CLI_ADDRESS: temporal:7233
    restart: "no"
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        set -eu
        until temporal operator cluster health --address temporal:7233 | grep -q SERVING; do
          echo "Waiting for Temporal server to start..."
          sleep 1
        done

        until temporal operator search-attribute list --address temporal:7233 --namespace default >/dev/null 2>&1; do
          echo "Waiting for namespace cache to refresh..."
          sleep 1
        done

        temporal operator search-attribute create --address temporal:7233 --namespace default --name ProjectId --type Keyword || true
        temporal operator search-attribute create --address temporal:7233 --namespace default --name ProjectVersion --type Int || true
        echo "Project search attributes registered."
        temporal operator namespace update --address temporal:7233 --namespace default --retention 60d
        tail -f /dev/null

  temporal-ui:
    image: temporalio/ui:2.44.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8233:8080"
    depends_on:
      temporal:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      TEMPORAL_ADDRESS: temporal:7233

  minio:
    image: minio/minio
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9000:9000"
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - minio_data:/data
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -fsS http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live >/dev/null"]
      interval: 3s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30

  minio-init:
    image: minio/mc
    depends_on:
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      DMS_BUCKET_NAME: dms-local
      TEMPORAL_S3_BUCKET_NAME: temporal-payloads
      QUARANTINE_BUCKET_NAME: quarantine-bucket
    restart: "no"
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        set -eu
        mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$$S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "$$S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
        mc mb -p "local/$$DMS_BUCKET_NAME" || true
        mc mb -p "local/$$TEMPORAL_S3_BUCKET_NAME" || true
        mc mb -p "local/$$QUARANTINE_BUCKET_NAME" || true
        tail -f /dev/null

  minio-proxy:
    # Host-restoring reverse proxy in front of MinIO for presigned URLs. An authenticating
    # reverse proxy may rewrite the inbound Host (real host -> X-Forwarded-Host), which would make
    # MinIO reject SigV4 presigned URLs with 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch. This sidecar restores
    # Host from X-Forwarded-Host before MinIO validates the signature. See
    # docker/minio-proxy/nginx.conf. Reached only over the compose network (via oauth2-proxy).
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ./docker/minio-proxy/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro

  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:v1.17.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "6333:6333"
      - "6334:6334"
    ulimits:
      nofile:
        soft: 65536
        hard: 65536
    volumes:
      - qdrant_data:/qdrant/storage

  tempo:
    image: grafana/tempo:2.9.0
    profiles: ["observability"]
    command: ["-config.file=/etc/tempo.yaml"]
    volumes:
      - ./docker/observability/tempo.yaml:/etc/tempo.yaml
      - tempo_data:/var/tempo
    ports:
      - "3200:3200"

  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.6.3
    profiles: ["observability"]
    command: ["-config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml"]
    volumes:
      - loki_data:/loki
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"

  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.142.0
    profiles: ["observability"]
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml"]
    volumes:
      - ./docker/observability/otel-collector.yaml:/etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml:ro
    environment:
      TEMPORAL_UI_HOST: http://localhost:8233
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"
      - "4318:4318"
    depends_on:
      - tempo
      - loki

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.4.2
    profiles: ["observability"]
    command:
      - "--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yaml"
